topic: Recap: hashrate, probability and why block luck varies
hook: Why can a huge miner still wait a long time for a block?

scenes.narration: Your chance per block is your share of the total network hashrate.
Finding a block is a matter of probability, so luck varies between miners.
Pools smooth payouts by sharing rewards in proportion to the work each miner contributes.
A bigger share raises your odds, but it never fixes the timing.

cta: Which lesson stuck with you this week? Comment below, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Weekly Recap: Hashrate, Probability and Luck
description_body: Your chance per block follows your hashrate share, and pools smooth payouts by sharing rewards by work contributed.
